text:
Rafe prefers print room for reviews. Jonah sends Nils morning meeting notes. Lifts near loading bay and east wing are slow. Harbour room coffee machine is working.

Pia is out; Jonah covers. Jonah, Ada, Vik, Esme, and Suri want loading bay, print room, library annex, and garden studio clear for visitors. Opal prefers north office for visitors (swapped with Dell); prefers east wing for reviews. Hugo prefers garden studio for reviews. Mira wants garden studio kept clear for visitors.

Desk swaps: Vik/Ines this week; Ada/Leon this week. Greta covers Bram (out). Morning stand-up in east wing; evening in garden studio.

Garden studio repainting (morning noise). Cora thinks library annex too cold. Rafe thinks print room too cold in evening. Nils thinks harbour room too cold in morning. Ines thinks east wing too cold in morning. Coffee machines in library annex, garden studio, loading bay, north office, print room, and east wing are working. Umbrellas left in east wing, print room, library annex, harbour room.

Jorworth reorder: 8,425. Jorbury reorder: 5,675. Calbury mileage cap: 1,050. Torhurst overdraft: 1,250. Finn is involved.
